name: Pi-hole
description: Registers your devices in Pi-hole's Local DNS (Pi-hole v6): an A record for every device Netlens knows and DNS does not, and a changed address for devices whose IP changed (DHCP). Pi-hole makes the reverse (PTR) answer by itself. Netlens only changes records it wrote itself (it remembers them, Pi-hole has no comment field) and never touches records you or anything else made.
author: Netlens
supports: Pi-hole v5 and older (not supported: different API)

releases.changelog: Run diagnostic no longer puts server addresses (host:port, IP addresses, host names) into the report. Nothing else changed.
First release. Needs Netlens 0.3.157 or newer.
